hook: Your night satellite view of Egypt shows one glowing ribbon.
title: Egypt From Space: One Glowing Ribbon
description:
Look at Egypt from space at night and you see one glowing ribbon in a black desert. That ribbon is the Nile, where most Egyptians live. The river decides where the lights are.

#Shorts #Egypt #NileRiver
comment_prompt: Could you live in a desert? Yes or no
